fields.label: Ward class the patient was admitted to
fields.description: The ward class the patient was actually admitted to for THIS admission, not the class their policy entitles them to. Answer with one of the listed options exactly as worded.

fields.label: Was this an emergency admission?
fields.description: Whether the patient was admitted through the emergency department or as an unplanned admission. A planned or elective admission is No. If the notes do not say either way, leave this missing rather than assuming.

fields.label: Name of hospital or medical institution
fields.description: The full name of the hospital or medical institution the patient was admitted to. Not the clinic that referred them, and not the doctor's own practice.

fields.label: Primary diagnosis category
fields.description: The body system the PRINCIPAL diagnosis belongs to — the condition that caused this admission, not an incidental or historical one. Answer with one of the listed options exactly as worded.

fields.label: Is this condition related to a pre-existing illness?
fields.description: Whether this condition arises from, or is a complication of, an illness the patient had before this admission. This drives whether an insurer pays, so answer Yes or No only where the notes state the prior illness; otherwise leave it missing for the doctor.

fields.label: Principal diagnosis and clinical findings
fields.description: The principal diagnosis in the doctor's own clinical wording, with the examination and investigation findings that support it. Free text; quote the note rather than paraphrasing it.
